  "title": "Delete user and plan and comment option ",
  "body": "Users occasionally ask for accounts to be deleted. It would be good to add an option to super-admin to do this - and maybe even on the 'edit profile' page so users can do it themselves? This would go beyond 'deactivating' users to:\r\n- delete email (replace with a generic stem email?)\r\n- remove name\r\n- remove org affiliation\r\n\r\nWe need to remove any personal and identifiable data for GDPR but don't want a hard delete as this could leave orphaned plans or affect other user data.\r\n\r\nAnd co-owned plans shouldn't be deleted as others still need access to them, and potentially the institution too?\r\n\r\nNotes / comment that the user has added could be deleted I think.\r\n\r\n@stephaniesimms @dsisu - can we define what we want in terms of functionality?\r\n",
  "author": "Participant 1",

  "state": "closed",

      "updated_at": "2018-05-17T14:51:58Z",
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "It should be sufficient for our purposes to set these values:\r\n* `\"firstname\"`: `'Deleted'`\r\n* `\"surname\"`: `'user'`\r\n* `\"email\"`: `'deleted@example.com'`\r\n* `\"recovery_email\"`: `'deleted@example.com'`\r\n* `\"org_id\"`: `nil`\r\n* `\"other_organisation\"`: `nil`\r\n* `\"encrypted_password\"`: `nil`\r\n* `\"orcid_id\"`: `nil`\r\n* `\"shibboleth_id\"`: `nil`\r\n* `\"current_sign_in_ip\"`: `nil`\r\n* `\"last_sign_in_ip\"`: `nil`\r\n* `\"active\"`: `false`\r\n\r\nWe can add the button/link to the user accounts table or inside the \"Edit\" popup (**only** for super admins)"

      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "Pulling this one up the list of priorities as I realise we don't even have a deactivate button anymore. Super-admins can't do anything to deactivate / remove / delete accounts when requests come in"

      "id": 434981162,

      "updated_at": null,

      "body": "In Denmark, we would highly appreciate this feature to be implemented!"

      "created_at": "2019-04-25T15:01:23Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "Maybe we should move this issue a bit higher up the list of priorities. Requests to delete users keep coming up. Currently we have to ask Sam to do this. Ideally, super-admins should be able to remove a user too. We must be able to do this on request. We should put this on the table for discussion and agree on procedures - users must approach us in writing and we must agree what to do with regards to plans that are co-owned."
